topic: Restoring surface conversion coatings, procedures and precautions.
syllabus_extract: Restoring surface conversion coatings, procedures and precautions.
specific_objectives: 6.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform rectification of corrosion.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of chemical conversion coating application on aluminum alloy panel. Safety precautions: Wear chemical-resistant gloves, safety goggles, and apron. Ensure adequate ventilation. Instructor supervision: Direct supervision required for all chemical handling steps.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a conversion coating on aircraft aluminum?
Name two common types of surface conversion coatings used in naval aviation.
Why is surface preparation critical before applying any conversion coating?

topics: Surface preparation techniques for coating restoration
development.content:
Surface preparation techniques for coating restoration
Chemical conversion coating application methods
Quality control checks post-application

Safety precautions during chemical handling
Environmental controls for coating process
Disposal of hazardous chemical waste

Inspection criteria for coating integrity
Rectification of defective coating areas
Documentation of maintenance actions

summary_questions: Describe the correct sequence for preparing a corroded aluminum surface before applying conversion coating.
What are the key safety precautions when handling chromate-based conversion coatings?
How do you verify that a conversion coating has been applied correctly?
home_assignment_question: Research the specific chemical composition and application temperature range for Alodine 1200S conversion coating as referenced in the master syllabus. Prepare a brief note on its compatibility with different aluminum alloys.
